title: Routing
description: Domains, APIs and operations that something other than the mock answers: a service at a URL, or a function passed in code. Per-environment configuration, read at boot; never part of a contract set.

Route.description: One domain, API or operation, and who answers it: exactly one of domain, api and operation, and one of to and handler.

domain.description: A domain the contracts declare, by the name of its directory, or * for every domain. Every route its APIs declare, and every event their state machines receive, is routed. With *, so is a request for a route the mock doesn't have, and any entry naming a domain, API or operation overrides it.

api.description: An API the contracts declare, by name: its OpenAPI file's name without -openapi.yaml, which its events AsyncAPI shares. Every route it declares, and every event its state machines receive, is routed. Overrides a domain entry for that API.

operation.description: One operation, by id: an OpenAPI operationId, or an AsyncAPI receive operation's. Bare when one API declares it, $apis.<api>.<id> when more than one does. Overrides a domain or API entry for that operation.

except.description: What stays in the mock, inside this entry: on a domain, an API in it or an operation; on *, any API or operation; on an API, an operation in it. Not on an operation entry.

to.description: Absolute base URL of the service that answers. For a request, its path is a prefix: the request's own path is appended to it. A received event is POSTed to it as written, in the CloudEvents HTTP binding's structured mode. May not carry a username or password: this file is configuration, and a credential belongs to the target, or to a header the caller sends and includeHeaders names.

handler.description: A function that answers instead, with fetch's signature: (Request) => Response. Passed in code only, so never in a file. A received event reaches it as the request to would have been sent. What it answers is checked against the operation's response schema.

includeHeaders.description: Headers to pass along beyond the default set, in either direction. Anything not named here or in the default set is dropped, credentials included.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the service before answering 504. Defaults to 10000.
